findings.evidence: grep `mdifferentiableAt_extendTrans(_symm)? hψm|hΨm` returns seven near-identical invocations in Graph.lean.
findings.fix: Add one private helper for a preferred chart with `Ψ = refl` (differentiability at a point and of its inverse, plus the left-inverse identity on tangent vectors) and use it at every site.
findings.issue: The same call `(chartAt …).mdifferentiableAt_extendTrans{,_symm} hm (Ψ := .refl _) contDiff_id (by simp) …` appears seven times (lines 108, 110, 114, 187, 189, 195, 196). The chart left-inverse/injectivity facts (`mfderiv_symm_apply_mfderiv_apply`, `mfderiv_apply_mfderiv_symm_apply`) are rebuilt in both `add_tangentEndomorphism_eq_iff` and `add_chartPushforward_graphStructure_eq_zero_iff_add`.

findings.evidence: Diff hunk for the new theorem `add_graphStructure_eq_zero_iff` in Inhomogeneous/Graph.lean.
findings.fix: Keep the two unfolding rewrites and the injectivity step, then close with a single `simp [ν.tangentHom_apply_j, J.tangentEndomorphism_apply_apply, j.apply_apply, sub_eq_zero, …]` or with `module`/`abel_nf`.
findings.issue: `add_graphStructure_eq_zero_iff` is proved by a `rw` of ten named lemmas (`graphStructure_apply, graphStructureAt_apply, apply_symm_apply, ← map_add, map_eq_zero_iff …, tangentHom_apply_j, map_neg, tangentEndomorphism_apply_apply, neg_neg, j.apply_apply`), then a `simp only`, then `rw [← sub_eq_zero (b := …), add_sub_assoc]`. It breaks on any rename or change in simp-normal form.

summary: The proofs are readable and the two definitional-equality closes (`Iff.rfl`, `rfl`) are commented, but the same chart-differentiability call appears seven times in the new Graph.lean instead of a shared helper. `add_graphStructure_eq_zero_iff` is closed by a brittle chain of ten named rewrites.
